entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Whether handlers target exact GW04 records or a programmer-defined family instruction set.
entries.RATIONALE: Separates dictionary cost from handler cost and permits an explicit encoder-alignment test.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: GW04 shows aggregate expressions only; a family can compare an aggregate to a direct scoped value.
ALTERNATIVES: two frozen variants: aggregate and lookup
entries.CHOICE: two frozen variants: aggregate and lookup
entries.RATIONALE: Smallest explicit generalization that preserves the GW04 form while allowing a direct structural value without a full expression language.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Meaning of other_links_than_left is not executable syntax by itself.
ALTERNATIVES: subtract subjects selected by the opposite equality side
entries.CHOICE: subtract subjects selected by the opposite equality side
entries.RATIONALE: Uses only structural set difference between the two equality sides and no world meaning.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: GW04 lists multiple missing fields but only the numeric balance determines a numeric value; no generic rule states how to infer a nonnumeric companion field.
ALTERNATIVES: derive only the uniquely determined numeric value
entries.CHOICE: derive only the uniquely determined numeric value
entries.RATIONALE: Avoids adding unrecorded domain semantics; a requested nonnumeric field remains NEED.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Whether observing fewer than the exact count proves a violation in an open world.
entries.RATIONALE: Observed absence is not completeness; overcount or non-distinctness is directly witnessed.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Representation of two incompatible current values.
entries.RATIONALE: Preserves history and does not fabricate a supersession policy.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Whether must_hold creates a new fact or is checked as a constraint.
entries.RATIONALE: Avoids ontology/fact invention. Exact consequent passes; competing current value blocks; missing consequent remains NEED.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: How the subject_binding field controls symbolic subject positions without recognizing any world-specific placeholder token.
ALTERNATIVES: recognize a fixed list of placeholder strings
let subject_binding alone force the request subject into the pattern
entries.CHOICE: let subject_binding alone force the request subject into the pattern
entries.RATIONALE: Keeps binding entirely field-driven and avoids hard-coded placeholder names from any tested world.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: How to know that an incoming fact depends on a rule without scanning arbitrary rule contents.
ALTERNATIVES: scan every field for predicate equality
entries.RATIONALE: Makes applicability explicit and auditable instead of heuristic.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Whether a numeric mismatch in an open membership universe is a conflict.
ALTERNATIVES: OPEN unless the relevant membership is closed
entries.CHOICE: OPEN unless relevant membership is closed
entries.RATIONALE: Prevents closed-world inference from incomplete membership.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Whether one closure declaration generalizes to other scopes.
entries.RATIONALE: The record names an exact scope and explicitly withholds closure elsewhere.

entries.UNDERSPECIFIED_POINT: Which records count as premises for aggregate derivation.
ALTERNATIVES: numeric expression records plus closure rule plus derivation rule
entries.CHOICE: numeric expression records plus closure rule plus derivation rule
entries.RATIONALE: These are the addressable records mechanically used by the derivation.

ALTERNATIVES: independent reviewer with explicit lossless-fit criterion
entries.CHOICE: independent reviewer with explicit lossless-fit criterion
entries.RATIONALE: This is a semantic evaluation judgment and must remain visible rather than hidden in code.
